use_scene.who: Support agents covering the off-hours billing rota
use_scene.where: Evenings and weekends at home, often in dim rooms, on laptops and sometimes a phone

brief.problem: Billing questions that arrive outside weekday day shifts wait for one of two specialists, so customers wait far longer than for other tickets.
brief.audience: Support agents without billing training who cover the off-hours rota, and the two billing specialists who review macros.
goals: A rota agent can take the next billing ticket and answer it with a reviewed macro.
Who covers tonight is visible without asking in chat.
constraints: Only reviewed macros may be offered to agents.
non_goals: Automatic replies sent without an agent.

direction.rationale: A dense working tool used at night: a dark ground because the rooms are dim, data set in a mono face because ticket times are compared at a glance, and one green accent only on the action that takes a ticket.

deliberate_risks.why: The tool should read as an instrument; rounded cards would make the queue look like marketing.

breakpoints.notes: Queue and macros sit side by side.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.notes: Sidebar navigation; the reply macros stay open beside the queue.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.notes: Queue, macros and rota in three columns.

requirements.requirement: Text and status colours meet 4.5:1 on the dark background and surface; borders and focus meet 3:1.
A 3px amber focus ring on every control.
Take a ticket, search and insert a macro, and request a swap with the keyboard alone.
Targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels, including bottom-bar tabs on phones.
Landmarks and a skip link to the main region.
The macro search explains an empty result and offers escalation.
At 200 percent text size, tables scroll in their frame and nothing overlaps.
Queue loading and offline messages are announced; errors assertively.
Waiting time is shown as text, never by colour alone.

statements.text: Off-hours rota agents work evenings and weekends from home, often in dim rooms, on laptops and sometimes a phone.
Billing tickets had a median first response of 31 hours versus 9 hours for other tickets in October 2026.
Only 2 agents are trained on billing.
Reviewed macros let agents without billing training answer common billing questions themselves.
Whether the company may use the proposed faces in this tool is unknown.
statements.resolution: Ask the requester for a licence record, or verify each face's official listing once public research is approved.

statements.text: Whether rota agents can take and answer a ticket without help is unknown.
statements.resolution: Run a task-based session with two rota agents on the preview after approval.

questions.text: What is the one thing a rota agent should remember after the first off-hours shift with this tool?

next_action.action: Ask the requester the memorable-thing question and for licence records of the three faces before the design is accepted.
